001package com.streamConverter;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.context.ExecutionContext;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStream;
007import java.io.OutputStream;
008import java.io.PipedInputStream;
009import java.io.PipedOutputStream;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.List;
012import java.util.Objects;
013import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
014import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
015import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
016import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
017import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
018import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
019import org.slf4j.Logger;
020import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
021
022/**
023 * ストリーム変換クラス。
024 *
025 * <p>ストリームを変換するクラス。ストリームを変換するコマンドを指定して、ストリームを変換する。
026 *
027 * <p>ストリームを変換するコマンドは、IStreamCommandインターフェースを実装したクラスである必要がある。
028 */
029public class StreamConverter {
030  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamConverter.class);
031  private static final int DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE = 64 * 1024; // 64KB buffer
032  private List<IStreamCommand> commands;
033  private ExecutionContext defaultContext;
034
035  /**
036   * Constructs a StreamConverter with the specified array of commands.
037   *
038   * @param commands the array of commands to be executed in sequence
039   * @throws NullPointerException if commands is null
040   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
041   */
042  public StreamConverter(IStreamCommand[] commands) {
043    Objects.requireNonNull(commands, "commands cannot be null");
044    if (commands.length == 0) {
045      throw new IllegalArgumentException("commands is empty.");
046    }
047    this.commands = List.of(commands);
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Constructs a StreamConverter with the specified list of commands.
052   *
053   * @param commands the list of commands to be executed in sequence
054   * @throws NullPointerException if commands is null
055   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
056   */
057  public StreamConverter(List<IStreamCommand> commands) {
058    Objects.requireNonNull(commands, "commands cannot be null");
059    if (commands.isEmpty()) {
060      throw new IllegalArgumentException("commands is empty.");
061    }
062    this.commands = new ArrayList<>(commands); // Defensive copy
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Creates a StreamConverter with the specified array of commands.
067   *
068   * @param commands the array of commands to be executed in sequence
069   * @return a new StreamConverter instance
070   * @throws NullPointerException if commands is null
071   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
072   */
073  public static StreamConverter create(IStreamCommand... commands) {
074    return new StreamConverter(commands);
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Creates a StreamConverter with the specified list of commands.
079   *
080   * @param commands the list of commands to be executed in sequence
081   * @return a new StreamConverter instance
082   * @throws NullPointerException if commands is null
083   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
084   */
085  public static StreamConverter create(List<IStreamCommand> commands) {
086    return new StreamConverter(commands);
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Creates a StreamConverter with a custom ExecutionContext and specified commands. All subsequent
091   * runs will use the provided context for MDC synchronization.
092   *
093   * @param context the execution context to use for MDC and logging
094   * @param commands the array of commands to be executed in sequence
095   * @return a new StreamConverter instance
096   * @throws NullPointerException if context or commands is null
097   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
098   */
099  public static StreamConverter createWithContext(
100      ExecutionContext context, IStreamCommand... commands) {
101    Objects.requireNonNull(context, "context cannot be null");
102    StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
103    converter.defaultContext = context;
104    return converter;
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Creates a StreamConverter with a custom ExecutionContext and specified commands list. All
109   * subsequent runs will use the provided context for MDC synchronization.
110   *
111   * @param context the execution context to use for MDC and logging
112   * @param commands the list of commands to be executed in sequence
113   * @return a new StreamConverter instance
114   * @throws NullPointerException if context or commands is null
115   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
116   */
117  public static StreamConverter createWithContext(
118      ExecutionContext context, List<IStreamCommand> commands) {
119    Objects.requireNonNull(context, "context cannot be null");
120    StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
121    converter.defaultContext = context;
122    return converter;
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Creates an optimal executor service based on available system resources and command count.
127   *
128   * @return an optimally configured ExecutorService
129   */
130  private ExecutorService createOptimalExecutor() {
131    int availableCores = Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors();
132    int optimalSize = Math.min(this.commands.size(), Math.max(2, availableCores));
133    return Executors.newFixedThreadPool(optimalSize);
134  }
135
136  /**
137   * 非同期並列処理でストリームを変換する。 メモリ効率を重視し、PipedStreamを使用して大容量ファイルに対応。 自動的にExecutionContextを生成してMDC同期を実現する。
138   *
139   * @param inputStream 処理対象の入力ストリーム
140   * @param outputStream 処理結果を書き込む出力ストリーム
141   * @return 各コマンドの実行結果リスト
142   * @throws IOException ストリーム処理中にI/Oエラーが発生した場合
143   */
144  public List<CommandResult> run(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
145      throws IOException {
146    // デフォルトコンテキストがあればそれを使用、なければ自動生成
147    ExecutionContext contextToUse =
148        defaultContext != null ? defaultContext : ExecutionContext.create();
149    return run(inputStream, outputStream, contextToUse);
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * カスタムExecutionContextを使用してストリームを変換する。 マルチスレッド環境でのMDCコンテキスト伝播とログトレーサビリティを実現。
154   *
155   * @param inputStream 処理対象の入力ストリーム
156   * @param outputStream 処理結果を書き込む出力ストリーム
157   * @param context 実行コンテキスト
158   * @return 各コマンドの実行結果リスト
159   * @throws IOException ストリーム処理中にI/Oエラーが発生した場合
160   */
161  public List<CommandResult> run(
162      InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream, ExecutionContext context)
163      throws IOException {
164    Objects.requireNonNull(inputStream);
165    Objects.requireNonNull(outputStream);
166    Objects.requireNonNull(context, "context cannot be null");
167
168    // パイプライン開始時にMDCコンテキストを設定
169    context.applyToMDCWithStage("pipeline-start");
170
171    LOG.info(
172        "Starting StreamConverter with {} commands (executionId: {})",
173        commands.size(),
174        context.getExecutionId());
175
176    // PipedStreamで並行処理（MDC対応）
177    return executeMultipleCommandsWithMDC(inputStream, outputStream, context);
178  }
179
180  /** コマンド（単一または複数）をMDC同期付きで並列実行 */
181  private List<CommandResult> executeMultipleCommandsWithMDC(
182      InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream, ExecutionContext context)
183      throws IOException {
184    ExecutorService executor = createOptimalExecutor();
185    List<CompletableFuture<CommandResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
186    List<AutoCloseable> resources = new ArrayList<>();
187
188    try {
189      InputStream currentInput = inputStream;
190
191      // パイプライン構築（MDC対応）
192      for (int i = 0; i < this.commands.size(); i++) {
193        IStreamCommand command = this.commands.get(i);
194        final int commandIndex = i; // Lambda用のfinal変数
195
196        final InputStream commandInput = currentInput;
197        final OutputStream commandOutput;
198
199        if (i == this.commands.size() - 1) {
200          // 最後のコマンド
201          commandOutput = outputStream;
202        } else {
203          // 中間コマンド: 次のコマンド用にPipedStreamペア作成
204          PipedOutputStream pipedOut = new PipedOutputStream();
205          PipedInputStream pipedIn = new PipedInputStream(pipedOut, DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE);
206          resources.add(pipedOut);
207          resources.add(pipedIn);
208          commandOutput = pipedOut;
209          currentInput = pipedIn;
210        }
211
212        // 各コマンドを非同期実行（MDC同期付き）
213        CompletableFuture<CommandResult> future =
214            CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(
215                () -> {
216                  // スレッド固有のMDC設定
217                  int sequence = context.getNextCommandSequence();
218                  String stageName = command.getClass().getSimpleName() + "-" + sequence;
219                  context.applyToMDCWithStage(stageName);
220
221                  LOG.info(
222                      "Setting up command {} of {}: {} (sequence: {})",
223                      commandIndex + 1,
224                      commands.size(),
225                      command.getClass().getSimpleName(),
226                      sequence);
227
228                  long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
229                  java.time.Instant startInstant = java.time.Instant.now();
230
231                  try {
232                    // コマンド実行（MDCは自動的に利用可能）
233                    command.execute(commandInput, commandOutput);
234
235                    // 中間の PipedOutputStream は実行完了後にクローズする必要がある
236                    if (commandOutput instanceof PipedOutputStream) {
237                      commandOutput.close();
238                    }
239
240                    long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
241                    java.time.Instant endInstant = java.time.Instant.now();
242
243                    LOG.info(
244                        "Completed command: {} (sequence: {})",
245                        command.getClass().getSimpleName(),
246                        sequence);
247
248                    return CommandResult.success(
249                        command.getClass().getSimpleName(),
250                        endTime - startTime,
251                        0L, // 入力バイト数
252                        0L, // 出力バイト数
253                        startInstant,
254                        endInstant);
255
256                  } catch (IOException e) {
257                    long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
258                    java.time.Instant endInstant = java.time.Instant.now();
259
260                    LOG.error(
261                        "Command execution failed: {} (sequence: {}) - {}",
262                        command.getClass().getSimpleName(),
263                        sequence,
264                        e.getMessage(),
265                        e);
266
267                    return CommandResult.failure(
268                        command.getClass().getSimpleName(),
269                        endTime - startTime,
270                        e.getMessage(),
271                        startInstant,
272                        endInstant);
273                  }
274                },
275                executor);
276
277        futures.add(future);
278      }
279
280      // すべてのタスクの完了を待機
281      List<CommandResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
282      for (CompletableFuture<CommandResult> future : futures) {
283        try {
284          // タイムアウト付きで待機（デッドロック防止）
285          CommandResult result = future.get(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
286          results.add(result);
287
288          // 失敗した場合は例外をスロー
289          if (!result.isSuccess()) {
290            throw new IOException("Command execution failed: " + result.getErrorMessage());
291          }
292
293        } catch (ExecutionException e) {
294          Throwable cause = e.getCause();
295          if (cause instanceof IOException) {
296            throw (IOException) cause;
297          } else if (cause instanceof RuntimeException) {
298            throw (RuntimeException) cause;
299          }
300          throw new IOException("Unexpected error during command execution", cause);
301        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
302          Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
303          throw new IOException("Command execution was interrupted", e);
304        } catch (TimeoutException e) {
305          throw new IOException("Command execution timed out after 60 seconds", e);
306        }
307      }
308
309      LOG.info("All commands completed successfully (executionId: {})", context.getExecutionId());
310      return results;
311
312    } finally {
313      // リソースクリーンアップ
314      shutdownExecutor(executor);
315      closeResources(resources);
316    }
317  }
318
319  /**
320   * ExecutorServiceを安全にシャットダウンする
321   *
322   * @param executor シャットダウン対象のExecutorService
323   */
324  private void shutdownExecutor(ExecutorService executor) {
325    executor.shutdown();
326    try {
327      if (!executor.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
328        LOG.warn("Executor did not terminate gracefully, forcing shutdown");
329        executor.shutdownNow();
330        if (!executor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
331          LOG.error("Executor did not terminate after forced shutdown");
332        }
333      }
334    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
335      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
336      executor.shutdownNow();
337    }
338  }
339
340  /**
341   * 使用したリソースを安全にクローズする
342   *
343   * @param resources クローズ対象のリソースリスト
344   */
345  private void closeResources(List<AutoCloseable> resources) {
346    for (AutoCloseable resource : resources) {
347      try {
348        resource.close();
349      } catch (Exception e) {
350        LOG.warn("Failed to close resource: {}", e.getMessage());
351      }
352    }
353  }
354}
